# Implementation: tracing architecture into the repository

Architecture components describe logical responsibility. Source modules show where that responsibility is actually implemented. Keeping those layers separate prevents a common traceability mistake: treating a Python or JavaScript file as if it were an architectural component.

The `source-module` objects below point to real files in this repository. Their `implements` relations connect code back to approved engineering obligations while the existing `implemented-by` relations continue to connect requirements to logical components and interfaces.

## Python semantic core

::: {.need #SRC-PARSER type="source-module" status="implemented" path="src/quarto_needs/parser.py" language="Python" layer="semantic-core" tags="parser;authoring;qmd" implements="FUN-001" part-of="COMP-PARSER"}
## QMD declaration parser module

Parses authored engineering declarations, source locations, attributes, rationale, and relation tokens from Quarto Markdown.
:::

::: {.need #SRC-RELATIONS type="source-module" status="implemented" path="src/quarto_needs/relations.py" language="Python" layer="semantic-core" tags="relations;semantics;graph" implements="FUN-002;NFR-005" part-of="COMP-ANALYSIS"}
## Canonical relation catalog module

Defines relation families, labels, endpoint roles, impact direction, traversal direction, and canonical traversal profiles.
:::

::: {.need #SRC-ANALYSIS type="source-module" status="implemented" path="src/quarto_needs/analysis.py" language="Python" layer="semantic-core" tags="analysis;snapshot;graph;semantics" implements="SYS-001;FUN-002;NFR-001;NFR-005" part-of="COMP-ANALYSIS"}
## Canonical analysis module

Turns declarations into the immutable engineering snapshot used by validation, queries, coverage, exports, and graph projections.
:::

::: {.need #SRC-RULES type="source-module" status="implemented" path="src/quarto_needs/rules.py" language="Python" layer="governance" tags="rules;governance;adr;risk" implements="SYS-003;SYS-004" part-of="COMP-RULES"}
## Governance rule module

Evaluates requirement, decision, risk, evidence, lifecycle, and review-date governance against the canonical snapshot.
:::

::: {.need #SRC-QUALITY type="source-module" status="implemented" path="src/quarto_needs/quality.py" language="Python" layer="governance" tags="quality;gates;coverage;ci" implements="SYS-003" part-of="COMP-RULES"}
## Quality-gate module

Builds deterministic quality reports and evaluates configured engineering gates over resolved project scopes.
:::

::: {.need #SRC-QUERIES type="source-module" status="implemented" path="src/quarto_needs/queries.py" language="Python" layer="semantic-core" tags="query;views;graph" implements="FUN-003;NFR-005" part-of="COMP-ANALYSIS"}
## Named-query module

Compiles and evaluates the bounded query language in the semantic core rather than in rendering clients.
:::

## Graph projection and exploration

::: {.need #SRC-GRAPH-OUTPUT type="source-module" status="implemented" path="src/quarto_needs/graph_output.py" language="Python" layer="projection" tags="graph;projection;provenance;security" implements="SYS-006;FUN-003;FUN-008;NFR-002;NFR-004" part-of="COMP-GRAPH"}
## Public graph output module

Publishes bounded graph JSON, semantic relation metadata, traversal profiles, named-query views, type roles, and safe declaration provenance.
:::

::: {.need #SRC-GRAPH-PROJECTION type="source-module" status="implemented" path="src/quarto_needs/graph_projection.py" language="Python" layer="projection" tags="graph;selection;projection" implements="SYS-006;FUN-004;NFR-004" part-of="COMP-GRAPH"}
## Graph selection and projection module

Selects bounded graph neighborhoods and builds deterministic projections consumed by static and interactive renderers.
:::

::: {.need #SRC-GRAPH-CONTEXT type="source-module" status="implemented" path="_extensions/quarto-needs/graph-context.js" language="JavaScript" layer="presentation" tags="graph;cytoscape;traversal" implements="FUN-004" part-of="COMP-GRAPH"}
## Cytoscape semantic context module

Consumes published traversal direction to implement recursive parents/children, collapse state, forced root paths, and hierarchy refresh.
:::

::: {.need #SRC-GRAPH-EXPLORE type="source-module" status="implemented" path="_extensions/quarto-needs/graph-explore.js" language="JavaScript" layer="presentation" tags="graph;cytoscape;exploration;filters" implements="FUN-004" part-of="COMP-GRAPH"}
## Cytoscape exploration module

Provides type/status/family filters, traversal profiles, path-to-root analysis, and semantic edge inspection without redefining relation meaning.
:::

## Presentation ergonomics

::: {.need #SRC-MARGIN-SIDEBAR type="source-module" status="implemented" path="_extensions/quarto-needs/margin-sidebar.js" language="JavaScript" layer="presentation" tags="quarto;toc;sidebar;usability;progressive-enhancement" implements="FUN-009" part-of="COMP-EXTENSION"}
## Margin TOC toggle module

Adds the optional persistent page-TOC collapse/restore control, coordinates temporary `fullcontent` state, and positions the expanded control entirely outside the margin sidebar.
:::

## Change analysis

::: {.need #SRC-BASELINE type="source-module" status="implemented" path="src/quarto_needs/baseline.py" language="Python" layer="comparison" tags="baseline;reproducibility;change" implements="FUN-005;NFR-001" part-of="COMP-BASELINE"}
## Baseline module

Captures reproducible authored state, configuration fingerprint, ruleset version, and reference date for later comparison.
:::

::: {.need #SRC-DIFF type="source-module" status="implemented" path="src/quarto_needs/diff.py" language="Python" layer="comparison" tags="diff;baseline;change" implements="FUN-005" part-of="COMP-BASELINE"}
## Engineering diff module

Compares baseline and current states and reports field, relation, relocation, addition, and removal changes deterministically.
:::

::: {.need #SRC-IMPACT type="source-module" status="implemented" path="src/quarto_needs/impact.py" language="Python" layer="comparison" tags="impact;baseline;change;graph" implements="FUN-005" part-of="COMP-BASELINE"}
## Impact traversal module

Traverses the union of baseline and current graphs and returns explicit auditable impact paths rather than an opaque risk score.
:::

## Localization and staged rendering

::: {.need #SRC-PRE-RENDER type="source-module" status="implemented" path="tools/quarto_needs_pre_render.py" language="Python" layer="integration" tags="localization;i18n;extension;render" implements="FUN-006;FUN-007;SYS-005" part-of="COMP-I18N"}
## Canonical pre-render integration module

Synchronizes extension assets, builds the engineering graph, checks localized semantic parity, and emits presentation-only title projections.
:::

## Extension-first distribution

::: {.need #SRC-QUARTO-INTEGRATION type="source-module" status="implemented" path="src/quarto_needs/quarto_integration.py" language="Python" layer="integration" tags="extension;render;canonical;distribution" implements="FUN-018;SYS-009" part-of="COMP-ANALYSIS"}
## Canonical Quarto pre-render application service

The one semantic build operation behind both `quarto-needs scan` and the extension bootstrap: analyze the project, materialize queries, precompute the quality report, and write every canonical artifact Quarto consumes.
:::

::: {.need #SRC-BOOTSTRAP type="source-module" status="implemented" path="_extensions/quarto-needs/bootstrap.py" language="Python" layer="integration" tags="extension;bootstrap;provisioning;distribution" implements="FUN-018;FUN-019;NFR-008;NFR-009" part-of="COMP-EXTENSION"}
## Managed-runtime bootstrap

Provisions the exact paired engine into a project-local runtime with staged, lock-protected, atomic installs, validates the imported version against the extension's own, renders offline from a valid cache, and invokes the canonical pre-render service.
:::

## Five vertical slices

The following slices are intentionally reused throughout the rest of the case study.

**Interactive graph exploration:** `STK-001 → SYS-006 → FUN-004 → ADR-004 → COMP-GRAPH → SRC-GRAPH-OUTPUT / SRC-GRAPH-CONTEXT / SRC-GRAPH-EXPLORE → TC-006 / TC-010 → EVD-006 / EVD-010`.

**Multilingual engineering:** `STK-005 → SYS-005 → FUN-006 → ADR-005 → COMP-I18N → SRC-PRE-RENDER → TC-005 → EVD-005`.

**Architecture decision management:** `STK-004 → SYS-004 → ADR-001…ADR-006 → SRC-RULES → TC-004 → EVD-004`.

**Engineering change analysis:** `STK-003 → SYS-003 → FUN-005 → COMP-BASELINE → SRC-BASELINE / SRC-DIFF / SRC-IMPACT → TC-011 → EVD-011`.

**Margin TOC usability:** `SYS-002 → FUN-009 → ADR-007 → COMP-EXTENSION → SRC-MARGIN-SIDEBAR → TC-014 → EVD-014`.

**Extension-first distribution:** `STK-008 → SYS-009 → FUN-018 / FUN-019 / NFR-008 / NFR-009 → ADR-019 → COMP-EXTENSION → SRC-QUARTO-INTEGRATION / SRC-BOOTSTRAP → TC-025…TC-031 → EVD-025…EVD-031`.
